question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Language __interacts__ with all aspects of human life and society.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"interacts"** means to act in such a way as to have an effect on another; it can refer to communication or direct involvement with something. (परस्पर क्रिया करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The teacher interacts with the students to make the lessons more engaging.
 
 
 
• **"Disconnects" **refers to breaking the connection between two or more things; it implies separation or detachment. (विच्छेद करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He disconnects the phone when he doesn't want to be disturbed.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'interacts' **is **'disconnects'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Intermingles **(मिलाना): To mix or mingle together.

 
 
• **Example:** The colors intermingles beautifully in the painting.
 
 
 
• **Co-operates **(सहयोग करना ): To work together towards a common goal.
 
 
• **Example: **The team co-operates to complete the project on time.
 
 
 
• **Interrelates** (परस्पर संबंधित होना): To relate or connect with each other.
 
 
• **Example:** The two subjects interrelates in many ways.
 
 

41:Tbd2,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
